grid.$description: Data cells and the sheet grid. A grid has corners.

chip.$description: Traits and rank pips, small and stamped.

sheet.$description: Bottom sheets, which meet the screen edge.

min.$description: Absolute floor. Nothing interactive is smaller.

default.$description: Standard control height on a phone.

separation.$description: Minimum gap between two adjacent tap targets so a mis-tap needs real travel.

viewport-min.$description: Smallest phone we lay out for.

viewport-target.$description: Design width. Players are on phones; there is no desktop target.

content-max.$description: Caps line length when a large phone or tablet is used.

bottom-bar.$description: Primary navigation sits in the thumb arc, not the top of the screen.

thumb-reach.$description: Fraction of viewport height from the bottom that a thumb covers one-handed. Primary actions live inside it.

hair.$description: Separation is a border, not a shadow. Shadows are only for things that genuinely float.
